> I read this as implementing Orca's two-layer split fallback for browser tabs dropped onto terminal pane edges - inspecting `TerminalSplitView.tsx` drag routing, updating `executeDrop` to branch by source tab kind, updating component and store drop tests, and verifying all related test suites and TypeScript checks.

### Summary of Changes

1. **`ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx`**:
   - In `executeDrop` under case `"move-tab-to-pane-split"`, checked the active drag source tab's kind:
     - If `sourceTab?.kind === "browser"`, invoked `onMoveTabToSplit(command.sourceTabId, targetGroupId, command.direction, command.position)` without `targetPane`.
     - Otherwise (terminal tabs), continued invoking `onMoveTabToSplit` with `{ tabId: command.targetTabId, leafId: command.targetLeafId }`.
   - Pane handle drag behavior (`move-pane-to-pane-split`) and existing tab group drop logic remain unchanged.

2. **`ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.browserPaneDrop.runtime.test.tsx`**:
   - Updated the component test assertions so that dropping a browser tab onto a terminal pane edge expects `onMoveTabToSplit` to be called with group-level arguments `("browser-source", "group-default", "horizontal", "second")` without `targetPane`.

3. **`ui/src/state/workspaceStore.browserPaneDrop.runtime.test.tsx`**:
   - Updated store integration invocation to call `moveTabToSplit("browser-source", targetGroupId, "horizontal", "second")`, verifying that the browser whole tab forms its own adjacent tab group split without merging into the terminal tab's `TabPaneLayout`.

### Verification

- Ran `bun --cwd ui vitest run src/components/TerminalSplitView.browserPaneDrop.runtime.test.tsx src/state/workspaceStore.browserPaneDrop.runtime.test.tsx src/components/TerminalSplitView.paneDrop.runtime.test.tsx src/components/TerminalSplitView.paneHandleDrop.runtime.test.tsx src/state/workspaceStore.tabDrop.test.tsx src/state/workspaceStore.paneDrop.runtime.test.tsx` -> **6/6 test files passed (13/13 tests passed)**.
- Ran `cd ui && bunx tsc --noEmit` -> **Exit 0 (clean compilation, zero type errors)**.

> I read this as addressing the redundant `onActivateTab` call in `handleDragOver` when dragging a tab over the already-active tab's pane edge - adding a failing component runtime test (RED), updating `TerminalSplitView.tsx` to guard against redundant activations (GREEN), and verifying all paneDrop, paneHandleDrop, browserPaneDrop, workspaceStore, and TypeScript checks pass.

### 2. Implementation

Updated `handleDragOver` in `ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx` to skip triggering `onActivateTab` when `previewTabId === normalizedLayout.activeTabId`:

```tsx
    if (
      !previewTabId ||
      previewTabId === active.tabId ||
      previewTabId === normalizedLayout.activeTabId ||
      previewedTabIdRef.current === previewTabId
    )
      return;
    previewedTabIdRef.current = previewTabId;
    onActivateTab(previewTabId);
```
